title: Nearest Village Finder: Closest Village
description: Look up settlement fields near a point. This workspace does not find or rank the nearest village.
summary_sentence: Nominatim may return a village, town or hamlet field for a nearby mapped object. The workspace does not calculate the nearest village.
quick_answer: This workspace reverse-geocodes a point and highlights a village, town or hamlet field when present. It does not scan nearby villages or calculate distance or direction.
steps_intro: Enter coordinates, search a place or click the map to inspect available settlement fields:

body.t: A settlement field may help orient a rural address, but verify the location before using it for deliveries.
A mapped settlement name is preliminary context, not a measured distance to shops or services.
For a breakdown or emergency, share your verified location directly with the relevant service. This lookup does not calculate the nearest village.
Use the mapped address field for orientation and consult local sources for access, services and routes.
When a reverse-geocoding result includes a village field, the workspace highlights that name. It may fall back to a town or hamlet field.
An absent village field does not prove that no village is nearby. The search does not rank settlements.

popular_table.title: Settlement lookup limits
popular_table.intro: The result comes from a nearby suitable mapped object, not a nearest-village calculation.
popular_table.note: Settlement names and coverage can vary; confirm important uses with a local source.

faq: Does this find the nearest village?
No. It reads a settlement field from a reverse-geocoding result, without ranking villages.
Does it give distance or direction?
No. Neither is calculated by this workspace.
Why might the settlement field be absent?
It may be missing in the returned record. This does not prove that no settlement exists nearby.
Can I search without device location?
Yes. Enter coordinates, search a place, or click the map. The selected coordinates are sent to Nominatim.
